interpretation: Under the same full network, rates, initial state, continuous boundary, units, time span, grid and tolerances used by the PINN physical operator, neither conventional one-pass stiff solver produced a trajectory within approximately ten minutes. This is evidence of prohibitive full-network stiff-ODE computation under the tested hardware and settings; it is not evidence of convergence to a near-zero solution.
